label: Ship Sh!t Show
status: draft: kit values are approved (2026-10-16), values marked proposed need Vincent's OK

sources.kit: shipshitshow/vault brand/ (tokens.json, identity.md, applications.md, editing.md, production.md), kit version 2026-10-16
sources.teaser: shipshitshow/vault production/2026-10-15-podcast-teaser/edit/render_teaser.py (the one built vertical clip; predates the 16 Oct kit)
sources.thumbnailRule: docs/branding.md in show.shipshit.dev, topic-first thumbnails without host faces, decided 2026-10-26
sources.proposed: written 2026-10-29 in this project thread; not in the kit

rules: no compressed, stacked or stretched lettering
typography.source: kit (web); applied to captions and thumbnail text by proposal

exclusions: box or square behind the mark
second copy over a baked-in signature

thumbnail16x9.rule: scale uniformly for other 16:9 exports (3840x2160: 288px at x3408/y1728)

slate1080p.source: kit (house starting value, verify against actual camera/caption/UI)

verticalCover9x16.source: proposed: same ratios as the 16:9 thumbnail; a cover is shown in grids, not over the Shorts feed UI

verticalClipInVideo.default: none, brand art stays distinct from factual footage (kit: Shorts)

content: one-line payoff in Space Grotesk Bold
endCard.source: teaser, restyled to the 16 Oct tokens by proposal

captions.fontFallback: Inter Bold (what the teaser used) then Montserrat Bold
captions.case: sentence case, spoken punctuation kept (the teaser did not uppercase)
captions.emphasisColor: none; a colored word must not change meaning or become a default karaoke effect (kit)

verticalPlacement.teaser: band from y1640 to the bottom edge of 1920
verticalPlacement.proposed: text block bottom edge at y1500 (78% of height), inside the central 900x1400 area; the teaser position sits under the Shorts title and channel line
verticalPlacement.note: no official safe-zone numbers exist; third-party guides disagree (bottom 250 to 672 px). Check one real Short on a phone.

captions.timing: from the final timeline, never full-stream timestamps; word timing only when it exists (YouTube word-timed subtitles can 429)
captions.verification: names, numbers and qualifications checked against the recording

clipLayout.twoHostStackVertical: two 480x420 crops (host cams) scaled to 960x840, stacked, padded to 1080x1920 on #0D0D0D, 60px side margin
clipLayout.twoHostLandscape: two crops side by side scaled 1920x840 on 1920x1080, 125px header
clipLayout.header: teaser used a 210px black band with SHIP SH!T SHOW (red, 30px) and the topic (82px); the 16 Oct kit asks for modest names and one small topic label, so shrink it
clipLayout.audio: loudnorm I=-16 TP=-1.5 LRA=11, 25ms fade in, 150ms fade out
clipLayout.encode: H.264 CRF 20, AAC 192k 48 kHz stereo, 30 fps, faststart

thumbnails.subjects: topic first, no host faces or likenesses (decided 2026-10-26); official topic logos in their own colors
thumbnails.text: optional, episode-specific, at most 4 words over 2 lines; thumbnails used uppercase Space Grotesk Bold, white, with one red line at most (the teaser thumbnails did this)
thumbnails.variants: exactly three distinct hypotheses per video; title held fixed for a thumbnail-only test; never call one a winner without a result

livestream.abTest: not for scheduled lives; allowed on completed live archives

recap.signature: white on dark, black on light

export.fileLimit: thumbnails.set reference currently says 50 MB (checked in PR 8653); older copies say 2 MB. Keep JPEG exports under 2 MB.

thumbnails.inspection: feed size: topic readable, text inside canvas, contrast, official logo accuracy, no duplicate signature

copyRules.name: Ship Sh!t Show, with no exclamation mark after Show
copyRules.baseline: Think AI, without a colon or trailing punctuation

titles.rule: name the subject and the conflict, title the observable result, no vague hype

copyRules.hooks: named topic and tension in the first 2 seconds; the clip must work cold in a feed
copyRules.description: short human opener, specific takeaway, accurate chapters, sources, footer: Subscribe so you don't miss the next build. Follow us: https://x.com/shipshitdev
forbidden: claims stronger than what was said

handoffRecord: technical checks reported separately from a watch-through review
